name: autoformat
description: The autoformat CLI: one file routing each path to the formatter its extension calls for. A workspace member only to inherit the pinned typecheck, lint, and test — ~/.local/bin/autoformat (home/default.nix) symlinks autoformat.ts itself and runs it under its shebang. Declare no dependencies here: a runtime dependency would make the CLI need an installed node_modules, so it would stop working wherever bun install has not been run. See the header of autoformat.ts.
